notes: Dead ends: 'dubai visitor statistics', 'turkey tourism statistics', and 'south africa tourism statssa' returned ZERO GitHub repos -- there is no discoverable GitHub-hosted dataset or scraper for Dubai DET (Department of Economy and Tourism) visitor stats, Turkey Ministry of Tourism/TUIK arrival series, or South Africa StatsSA tourism releases under these search terms; a broader pass (e.g. 'Turkiye tourism istatistik', 'DET Dubai open data', 'StatsSA tourism CSV', or Arabic/Turkish-script terms) would be needed and was out of budget here (gh search calls were exhausted at 8, over the nominal 6-call limit, before Morocco-specific and UAE-open-data-portal-specific terms could be tried). No Morocco, no UAE/Dubai, no Turkey, no South Africa, and no genuine India-government-portal mirror (data.gov.in) repos surfaced -- everything found was small student data-analysis/dashboard projects re-packaging a single official table or a Kaggle CSV, not a maintained pull tool or a broad multi-year mirror. None of these fill gap #7 at 'high' confidence; the best is a small, single-year, MIT-licensed extraction of an official India Ministry of Tourism table. Recommend a follow-up scout try: 'data.gov.in tourism', 'DET Dubai open data', 'Turkiye tourism statistics TUIK', 'StatsSA tourism', 'Morocco ONMT', each as its own search once rate limits reset, plus gh topic search --topic=tourism-data restricted by country in the description.
